Title: Complete transfer to a saved beneficiary
Preconditions: Customer is authenticated; account NB-UAT-ACC-001 has available balance 1,500.00; beneficiary NB-UAT-BEN-001 'Maria Lopez' is saved and active
Test Steps: 1) Open Instant Transfer; 2) Select saved beneficiary 'Maria Lopez'; 3) Enter amount 250.00; 4) Confirm transfer
Expected Result: Transfer accepted; 250.00 debited; confirmation shows a unique reference; status Completed

Title: Reject transfer with insufficient balance
Preconditions: Customer is authenticated; account NB-UAT-ACC-002 has available balance 100.00; beneficiary NB-UAT-BEN-001 is saved
Test Steps: 1) Open Instant Transfer; 2) Select saved beneficiary; 3) Enter amount 150.00; 4) Confirm transfer
Expected Result: Transfer rejected; message 'Insufficient available balance' shown; no debit; balance unchanged
Actual Result: Rejected as expected, but the error text read 'Funds unavailable' instead of the agreed message

Title: Add a new beneficiary with re-authentication
Test Steps: 1) Add a new beneficiary with valid account details; 2) Submit the form; 3) Complete re-authentication when prompted
Expected Result: Re-authentication requested; after success the beneficiary is saved and available for future transfers

Title: Block beneficiary failing sanctions screening
Preconditions: Customer is authenticated; sanctions screening is active in UAT
Test Steps: 1) Add a beneficiary matching a sanctions list entry; 2) Submit and let screening run
Expected Result: Beneficiary blocked; message 'We cannot process transfers to this beneficiary' shown; event reported to Compliance; beneficiary not available

Title: On-us transfer settles in under 10 seconds
Preconditions: Both sender and beneficiary hold NovaBank accounts and are funded
Test Steps: 1) Open Instant Transfer; 2) Select an on-us beneficiary; 3) Enter amount 100.00; 4) Confirm and measure settlement time
Expected Result: Transfer settles in under 10 seconds; beneficiary balance increases by 100.00; status Completed

Title: Off-us transfer accepted by the rail
Preconditions: Beneficiary account is held at a participating bank; rail simulator is available
Test Steps: 1) Open Instant Transfer; 2) Select an off-us beneficiary; 3) Enter amount 300.00; 4) Confirm and observe the rail acknowledgement
Expected Result: Transfer submitted to the real-time rail; on acknowledgement status becomes Completed

Title: Off-us transfer rail timeout becomes Pending
Preconditions: Rail simulator is configured to not acknowledge the transfer
Test Steps: 1) Submit an off-us transfer of 300.00; 2) Wait more than 30 seconds; 3) Check transfer status and notifications
Expected Result: Status becomes 'Pending'; transfer queued for reconciliation; customer notified that the transfer is pending
Actual Result: Status stayed 'Processing' and never changed to Pending after 60 seconds; no pending notification was sent

Title: Reject amount below the minimum
Test Steps: 1) Initiate a transfer; 2) Enter amount 0.50; 3) Confirm
Expected Result: Transfer rejected because the amount is below the 1.00 minimum; no debit

Title: Reject amount above available balance
Test Steps: 1) Initiate a transfer; 2) Enter amount 2,000.00; 3) Confirm
Expected Result: Transfer rejected for exceeding the available balance; no debit; balance unchanged

Title: Enforce and configure daily limits
Test Steps: 1) Open limit settings; 2) Set a personal daily limit of 2,000.00; 3) Attempt a transfer of 3,000.00 the same day; 4) Confirm
Expected Result: Transfer rejected for exceeding the daily limit; the new limit is confirmed to the customer
Actual Result: Personal limit was saved, but a 3,000.00 transfer was processed successfully, exceeding the configured limit

Title: Low-risk transfer passes fraud screening
Preconditions: Fraud engine is configured to score the transfer as low risk
Test Steps: 1) Initiate a transfer of 120.00; 2) Confirm and observe the fraud decision
Expected Result: Transfer proceeds to settlement without additional checks; status Completed

Title: High-risk transfer held for review
Preconditions: Fraud engine must be configured to score the transfer as high risk
Test Steps: 1) Configure the high-risk profile; 2) Initiate a transfer of 4,500.00; 3) Confirm and observe the outcome
Expected Result: Status 'Held for review'; funds not debited; customer notified that the transfer is under review
Actual Result: Could not execute: the fraud engine UAT rules could not be activated during the test window

Title: Customer receives outcome notification
Preconditions: Customer has a registered device and email
Test Steps: 1) Complete a successful transfer; 2) Check the device for a push notification; 3) Check the email inbox
Expected Result: Push notification and email received, including amount, beneficiary and reference
Actual Result: Email received, but no push notification was delivered for the successful transfer

Title: Rail rejection releases funds
Preconditions: Rail simulator is configured to reject the transfer
Test Steps: 1) Submit an off-us transfer of 250.00; 2) Observe the rail response; 3) Check the account balance and notification
Expected Result: Status 'Rejected'; no funds debited; customer notified with the rejection reason

Title: Returned transfer credited within 1 business day
Preconditions: A previously settled off-us transfer exists and the receiving bank returns it
Test Steps: 1) Process the return from the receiving bank; 2) Check the sender account balance and notification
Expected Result: Funds credited back to the sender within 1 business day; customer notified of the return
Actual Result: Funds credited back within 2 hours; customer notified

Title: Filter history and download a receipt
Test Steps: 1) Open transfer history; 2) Filter by status 'Completed'; 3) Download the receipt for a transfer
Expected Result: Only completed transfers listed with date, beneficiary, amount and status; receipt contains reference, amount and timestamp
Actual Result: Filter works, but the downloaded receipt shows the amount with the wrong currency symbol and omits the transfer reference

Title: Operations search pending transfers
Preconditions: Operations user is authenticated; at least one pending transfer exists
Test Steps: 1) Log in to the operations back-office; 2) Filter transfers by status 'Pending' and age greater than 5 minutes
Expected Result: Matching transfers are listed with their references and age

Title: Operations manually resolve a pending transfer
Test Steps: 1) Open the pending transfer; 2) Confirm it was not settled at the rail; 3) Mark the transfer as 'Rejected'
Expected Result: Transfer marked 'Rejected'; funds released back to the customer; customer notified
